annotation.interpretation_a: A server could interpret this as requiring a minimum *data* transfer speed, discarding connections that don't send data at a sufficient rate.
annotation.interpretation_b: A server could interpret this as requiring a minimum *packet* transfer speed, discarding connections that don't send packets at a sufficient rate, even if those packets contain only ACKs or other control information.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'minimum transfer speed' is underspecified. It is unclear whether 'transfer speed' refers to data transfer or packet transfer, leading to different implementation choices.
